body.x: Soy(www.szsoy.com) introduced its DC adapter and charging adapter at Korea Electronics Show 2016, which runs Oct. 26-29 at COEX.

Displayed at CCPIT joint hall, Soy is a Chinese company that manufactures DC adapters and charging adapters, with 90% of its products receiving KE mark. It also received CE, FC, and UL mark, being proven for its quality.
65W Laptop Adapter for laptops and smartphones has five ports, making simultaneous charging possible. A staff at Soy said its products are being supplied to all over the world, including HP.

Hosted by MOTIE and organized by KEA, KES 2016 is the major international electronics and IT trade show in Korea where the convergence solution in the leading fields like electronics, ICT, semiconductors, and display and industry and IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education, smart factory, and e-health is displayed.
